title: In Blender, adjust the Noise settings (e.g., on camera motion/F-Curves) to add…
content: In Blender, adjust the Noise settings (e.g., on camera motion/F-Curves) to add natural-looking camera movement before using it with Seedance.
tips: In Blender, adjust the Noise settings (e.g., on camera motion/F-Curves) to add natural-looking camera movement before using it with Seedance.

es.content: En Blender, ajusta la configuración de Noise (por ejemplo, en el movimiento de cámara/F-Curves) para añadir un movimiento de cámara de aspecto natural antes de usarlo con Seedance.

fr.content: Dans Blender, ajustez les paramètres de Noise (par exemple, sur le mouvement de la caméra/F-Curves) pour ajouter un mouvement de caméra d'apparence naturelle avant de l'utiliser avec Seedance.

ja.content: Blenderで、Seedanceを使用する前にカメラの動きやFカーブのノイズ設定を調整して、自然なカメラの動きを追加します。

ko.content: Blender에서 Seedance를 사용하기 전에 자연스러운 카메라 움직임을 추가하기 위해 노이즈 설정(예: 카메라 모션/F-Curves)을 조정하세요.

pt.content: No Blender, ajuste as configurações de Noise (por exemplo, no movimento da câmera/F-Curves) para adicionar um movimento de câmera com aparência natural antes de usá-lo com o Seedance.

zh.content: 在 Blender 中，调整噪声设置（例如，在相机运动/F-Curves 上）以添加自然的相机运动，然后再与 Seedance 一起使用。
